data_fields.name: spawn_point_maximum
data_fields.donor_constant: set per spawn (_maximumCount); cap is alive + queued < maximum

data_fields.name: respawn_random_spread
data_fields.donor_constant: set per template (randomInterval); band = delay +/- random

data_fields.name: respawn_start_event
data_fields.donor_constant: corpse decay (onDecay), not the killing blow

best_idea: A respawn queue per spawn point that counts down when a corpse decays, schedules the respawn at a random time inside a delay band, and refuses to queue when alive plus already-queued would reach the cap.
decision_why: The cap rule (alive plus queued under the maximum), the random band with a 10 s floor and the fixed sweep fit row 23's respawn; the donor's decay trigger and same-object reuse do not fit Frankendom's server-verified kills and one ledger, so the trigger and the id are changed.
acceptance: A server test with a spawn point at maximum 3 kills three creatures and asserts no respawn is queued until a corpse is removed, each queued respawn fires after its band delay and never under 10 seconds, and alive plus queued never exceeds 3.
